description: Manage a character's durable identity: staged candidates, accepted facets, and the versioned compiled kernel. A Novel entity or NPC uses the Novel-tier identity map; a roster-only character uses its roster baseline. stage imports or authors identity material with a psyche kind, self-awareness, optional false-but-held belief, valence, date bounds, and contradiction links; accept replaces a facet, retains the displaced value, and bumps the version; reject marks a candidate rejected; revert restores the most recently displaced facet; bootstrap seeds from a character card. Mutation persists to the owning tier, is audited, and a Novel-tier mutation is undoable; list and snapshot are read-only, and a Player reads its own projected kernel. Use when: staging, accepting, rejecting, reverting, or reading identity. Do NOT use when: recording knowledge or belief — use manage_belief; editing narrative personality — use manage_character (action: personality).

action.description: stage, accept, reject, revert, list, snapshot, or bootstrap.

awareness.description: Whether the character knows this about itself (stage; default yes).

character_id.description: Character id: a Novel entity, NPC, or roster character.

contradicts.description: Facet keys a contradiction facet holds in tension (stage).

facet.description: Identity facet key, e.g. name or calling (stage).

false_but_held.description: Belief kind only: the character holds it and it is false (stage).

perspective.description: self, biographical, public_reputation, secret, or unknown (stage/accept; default self).

source.description: Provenance label for the candidate (stage; default manual).

stability.description: structural, constitutional, core, or developmental (stage; default core).

valence.description: Stance or taste kind only: hostile (-100) to warm (+100) (stage).

name: manage_identity

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or ERROR; an error's Appendix O.2 category rides in `category` (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Identity Management
